sentence: This project expands a field lab that stores soil and plant samples and prepares samples for long-term research on fields, grasslands, and forests.
This project studies how stacked, extremely thin layers of matter switch between conducting, insulating, and superconducting states, using optical and electrical measurements.
This project gets an instrument that builds devices in 3D without a cleanroom, for optics, electronics, mechanics, and tissue engineering.
This project studies how ring-shaped building blocks with different strain join together into long chains, and how catalyst and solvent affect the result.
This project builds ways to spot cyberattacks on gas, water, and power networks without moving sensitive data away from the groups that run them.
This project works with industry and government to apply quantum communications, quantum sensing, and quantum computing to real-world problems.
This project develops ways for power grids made of many independent agents to make decisions faster, recover from disruptions, and account for social benefits.
This project studies how stress compounds called aldoximes help plants balance growth and defense in Arabidopsis and tomato.
This project applies mathematics and statistics to scientific problems, such as the human brain, traffic, quantum computing, and the design of materials.
This project builds microscopic liquid droplets made of DNA and RNA that can separate and sort molecules, taking inspiration from how cells organize their contents.
This project studies polymers, including sustainable polymers and materials that can be reprocessed, using laboratory work, computational modeling, and machine learning tools.
This project tests whether neurons in Drosophila melanogaster treat all incoming signals equally, no matter where they land on their dendrites.
This project develops ways for robots to recover after failing to grasp an object, including in cluttered places and underwater.
This project studies how massless electrons and magnetism affect each other in a group of materials, using infrared light at low temperatures and magnetic fields.
This project builds a system that uses several kinds of data to check how safely people drive mobility scooters.
This project studies how small-scale farmers work with agronomists and engineers to build digital tools that fit their farms as the environment changes.
This project builds a community that shares and improves a free computer program that simulates self-driving vehicles.
